$sources: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.2.1 (importance categories), Table 4.1.8.5 (IE), Table 4.1.7.3 (IW, ULS)
source: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.2.1: the importance categories Low, Normal, High and Post-disaster (SAEngine ids I to IV); IE of Table 4.1.8.5 and IW (ULS) of Table 4.1.7.3; IS (ULS) is the snow table's importance

I.description: Low importance: low direct or indirect hazard to human life (low human-occupancy buildings, minor storage)

II.description: Normal importance: all buildings not in Low, High or Post-disaster

III.description: High importance: likely used as post-disaster shelters (elementary, middle and secondary schools, community centres) and buildings with toxic, explosive or hazardous substances

IV.description: Post-disaster: essential to provide services after a disaster (hospitals, fire, police and rescue stations, communication and power facilities)

sources.categories: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.2.1; IE 0.8, 1.0, 1.3, 1.5 (Table 4.1.8.5); IW (ULS) 0.8, 1.0, 1.15, 1.25 (Table 4.1.7.3). The SLS importance factors (IW 0.75, IS 0.9, ...) are not used by the program (the SLS combinations take the service wind as a share of W)
